nodes.label: Public and Reproducible Data
nodes.rationale: The methodology states that all data are public and that the scripts producing each table are available in the repository.

nodes.label: Composite Neighborhood Index
nodes.rationale: Each axis is normalized from 0 to 100 and the index is a weighted average whose weights can be adjusted on the map.

nodes.label: Methodological Limitations
nodes.rationale: Income is weighted by responsible persons because IBGE does not report the number of earners; Praia de Iracema is mapped to AIS 08; Strava is visual context and does not enter the index.
